verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Persona has per-key API Key Configuration that can restrict which IPs a key accepts requests from. That limits where a credential can be used, but nothing shows permission scoping, resource or action-level limits, or agent-specific keys. Missing for 10: documented permission/scope selection per API key, least-privilege role or resource restrictions, expiring or revocable agent-specific credentials, independent corroboration.
